key_insight: Evidence-grounded language models guided perovskite contact design, selecting a K analogue that outperformed the Na analogue preferred by experts.
engineering_relevance: Devices using the AI-selected contact achieved 27.05% efficiency and retained 96.74% of initial efficiency after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85 °C.
method: Reconstructed expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 training articles.
Adapted models using linked experimental strategies, controls, observations and mechanistic interpretations.
Used retrieved evidence to revise selected passages and tested a model-recommended contact experimentally.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted OpenPerov Pro increased Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1.
watch_item: The reported stability test used dark thermal ageing, so durability under illumination and real-world operating conditions remains to be established.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
